<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Functional\Api;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Test\WebTestCase;

use function json_encode;

/**
 * Test __API_TEST_CLASS__.
 *
 * @category Functional Tests
 *
 * @author __AUTHOR__
 */
final class __API_TEST_CLASS__ extends WebTestCase
{
  // #region Methods
  /**
   * Method test__COLLECTION_ENDPOINT_TEST_NAME__.
   *
   * Tests that the collection endpoint enforces the expected contract.
   */
  #[Test]
  public function test__COLLECTION_ENDPOINT_TEST_NAME__(): void
  {
    $client = static::createClient();

    $client->request('__COLLECTION_HTTP_METHOD__', '__COLLECTION_URI__');

    $statusCode = $client->getResponse()->getStatusCode();

    self::assertContains(
      needle: $statusCode,
      haystack: [__COLLECTION_EXPECTED_STATUS_LIST__],
      message: '__COLLECTION_ASSERTION_MESSAGE__' . $statusCode,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Method test__CREATE_ENDPOINT_TEST_NAME__.
   *
   * Tests that create behavior enforces the expected contract.
   */
  #[Test]
  public function test__CREATE_ENDPOINT_TEST_NAME__(): void
  {
    $client = static::createClient();

    $client->request(
      method: 'POST',
      uri: '__CREATE_URI__',
      server: ['CONTENT_TYPE' => 'application/json'],
      content: (string) json_encode(__CREATE_PAYLOAD__),
    );

    $statusCode = $client->getResponse()->getStatusCode();

    self::assertContains(
      needle: $statusCode,
      haystack: [__CREATE_EXPECTED_STATUS_LIST__],
      message: '__CREATE_ASSERTION_MESSAGE__' . $statusCode,
    );
  }
  // #endregion
}
